stay.quote: Experience the beauty of Lion Sands Game Reserve, where every moment invites you to reconnect with nature, with others, and with yourself.
stay.bestMonthsNote: Wildlife viewing is the best during the dry winter season spanning from May - Sept.

why.body: Explore 4 luxury lodges & 2 private residences that blend seamlessly in the environment.

Stay within 6.5 miles of exclusive river frontage on the perennial Sabie River attracting a diversity of wildlife. Welcome this beautiful world, where the most amazing family of people will take care of your every heartfelt need.

camps.name: Ivory Lodge
camps.intro: Where Nature and Luxury Become One
camps.description:
At Ivory Lodge, eight exclusive suites offer the ultimate in privacy and comfort, each with a private lounge, deck, and plunge pool overlooking the wild riverscape. 

 Every detail — from your favorite wine stocked in your maxi bar to personalized safari experiences — is tailored just for you.

camps.name: River Lodge
camps.intro: Appreciate River Lodge’s bright, contemporary charm, blending luxury with tradition for a connection-rich safari.
camps.description:
Discover the soul of Africa at Lion Sands River Lodge, nestled along the Sabie River in the world renowned Sabi Sands Game Reserve.
With just 18 luxury suites, the lodge offers an exclusive and deeply personal safari experience surrounded by breathtaking wilderness.
Watch the Big Five from your private deck, embark on guided bush walks, and immerse yourself in the rhythms of the wild. Natural beauty flows through every moment, from serene riverside views to starlit boma feasts.
"At Lion Sands River Lodge, you don’t just visit the wild, you become part of it," says James Papagno. "It is a place that touches your soul and calls you back to nature."

camps.name: Narina Lodge
camps.intro: Discover Lion Sands Narina Lodge, Elevated among 100-year-old trees along the Sabi River, this exclusive lodge offers private plunge pools, wooden walkways, and breathtaking views of the bush veld. Experience refined safari living, unforgettable game drives, and an intimate connection to nature.
camps.description: Stay at Lion Sands Narina Lodge, featuring just nine private suites elevated above the Sabi River in South Africa’s Kruger National Park.Enjoy plunge pools, sweeping bushveld views, and intimate Big Five safari experiences.Soak up the simple pleasures of life and the deep connection with the river and nature. Living feels easy here.Narina Lodge lets you feel Africa’s soul in absolute comfort.

camps.name: Tinga Lodge
camps.intro: Tinga Lodge brings back the soul of old world safaris with a new level of comfort. It’s a place where you’ll not just see the wild, you’ll feel a part of it.
camps.description: River Facing Luxury at Lion Sands Tinga Lodge Discover nine elegant suites overlooking the Sabie River, where vintage safari style meets modern luxury. Each suite offers a private deck and plunge pool, perfect for watching hippos, elephants, and giraffes pass by.Unwind in your riverside sanctuary, then connect via elevated walkways to the main lodge with its spa, bar lounge, pool, and open air boma.At night, fall asleep to the soothing sounds of the African bush, a true Big 5 safari experience in the heart of Sabi Sand Reserve.

camps.name: Fish Eagle Residence
camps.intro: A private safari retreat on the Sabie River with exclusive game drives, a personal service team, and front-row wildlife views
camps.description:
Tucked deep along the Sabi River, Fish Eagle Residence is your private gateway to Africa’s soul. Here, nature comes to you, with elephants drinking at the river and birds carving the sky, while you savor every moment from your own secluded sanctuary. 
With private air access and a hidden entrance, your days are yours to shape. Drift between sunrise safaris, barefoot bush walks, quiet family meals, refreshing swims in the 10 m lap pool, and wellness rituals set to the sounds of the wild. 
Your personal team, including a concierge, chef, butler, and field guide, ensures every detail is effortless. At Fish Eagle Residence, time slows, nature breathes, and you rediscover the luxury of simply being.

stay.tagline: "Londolozi: Where Wild Africa Awakens the Soul"
stay.quote: The camps & villas of the Londolozi Reserve offers an harmonious blend of heritage and luxury, providing guests with an authentic safari experience deeply rooted in family tradition and a profound connection to the land.
stay.bestMonthsNote:
May to October - Dry Season / Prime Safari Time These cooler, drier months are widely considered the best time to visit Londolozi for exceptional wildlife viewing. Here's why:
Unmatched Wildlife Sightings. Vegetation is sparse, and animals gather around waterholes, making them easier to spot. Leopard sightings are more frequent.
stay.airportDirections: In short there are three major airport serving the Sabi Sands: Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport (for lodges in the western sector) Skukuza Airport (for lodges in the southern sector) Hoedspruit Eastgate Airport (for lodges in the northern sector) We are happy to assist with road transfers from any of these airports to your lodge (only in combination with a confirmed reservation).

why.title: A Spiritual Return to the Wild - An Original
why.body: Londolozi is not just a safari destination. It’s a spiritual return to the wild, a sanctuary where nature, luxury, and legacy converge to offer something truly rare: deep, personal transformation. You're not just witnessing the wild. You’re becoming part of it.

paras: Camps and Villas thoughtfully cater to both families and couples, featuring private heated plunge pools, open-air bathtubs, and interconnected suite options. Designed with a strong focus on togetherness, each space reflects Londolozi’s deep commitment to family and community.

onlyHere: At Londolozi, safari is a journey of self-discovery, offering unmatched leopard sightings, soulful wellness experiences, and camps with unique character. Rooted in a legacy of conservation and storytelling, each stay supports sustainability and empowers local communities. Where luxury meets purpose in the wild. Each of the distinctive, soulful camps has its own unique vibe, thoughtfully designed to reflect the rhythm of the land.

camps.name: Founders Camp
camps.intro: Londolozi Founders Camp is a family-friendly luxury safari lodge in South Africa’s Sabi Sand Game Reserve, offering river-view chalets and unforgettable Big Five game drives. Set under ancient ebony trees, this camp blends heritage and comfort, making it ideal for families, couples, and multi-generational travelers.
camps.description: Londolozi Founders Camp is a family friendly luxury safari lodge in South Africa’s Sabi Sand Game Reserve, offering river view chalets and unforgettable Big Five game drives. Set under ancient ebony trees, this camp blends heritage and comfort, making it ideal for families, couples, and multi generational travelers. With inter leading suites, private decks, daily yoga, and immersive bush experiences, guests enjoy close wildlife encounters, thoughtful hospitality, and a deep sense of connection to nature, making it a soulful, accessible safari for all ages.

Complimentary daily yoga on a deck built into a 500-year-old ebony tree

camps.name: Varty Camp
camps.intro: Varty Camp is the original heart of Londolozi, where a century-old campfire still burns in tribute to the land’s legacy. Nestled along the Sand River, this iconic family-friendly safari camp features timber-decked chalets with private pools, outdoor showers, and shaded forest views. Interleading rooms welcome children aged six and up, making it ideal for families.

camps.name: Tree Camp
camps.description: Londolozi Tree Camp is an ultra-luxury safari lodge set high in the treetops of South Africa’s Sabi Sand Game Reserve, offering a serene and romantic retreat for discerning travelers. With just six exclusive suites, each featuring private plunge pools, elegant interiors, and elevated views of the Sand River, Tree Camp promises unmatched privacy and style. Known for extraordinary leopard sightings, world-class game drives, and tranquil wellness experiences, it is ideal for couples and honeymooners seeking a sophisticated safari escape. The camp does not accommodate children under the age of 16

camps.name: Private Granite Suites
camps.description: Londolozi’s Private Granite Suites offer an exclusive, ultra-luxury safari experience in the heart of South Africa’s Sabi Sand Game Reserve. Designed for discerning travelers and honeymooners, these three private suites feature seamless indoor-outdoor living, bold granite finishes, riverfront plunge pools, and outdoor bathtubs with panoramic wildlife views. With award-winning game drives, gourmet dining, and personalized service, the Granite Suites provide a secluded, elegant retreat immersed in nature. Ideal for private bookings or romantic escapes.

camps.name: Private Villas
camps.intro: Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or craving space to reconnect, Londolozi’s private villas combine refined design, wild luxury, and deep immersion in nature—creating a safari retreat like no other. Pioneer Homestead Villa Many families have come and visited Londolozi’s Pioneer Homestead looking for privacy and exclusive use of a home in Africa. The wonderful thing about Pioneer Homestead is that, because it has only three suites, private and exclusive use is easy and very popular for groups of friends travelling together and multi-generational families.

From the ultra-luxurious Granite Suites overlooking the Sand River to the heritage-rich Pioneer Camp with interconnecting skywalks, each villa provides private plunge pools, personalized service, and world-class game drives.

stay.quote: Venture into a wild canvas where every sunrise and star-lit evening rekindle your spirit. This is Lalibela.
stay.bestMonthsNote: Dry months with optimal wildlife viewing attracted to waterholes, crisp sunny days, and clearer skies for game-spotting and star-gazing.
stay.airport: 25. Airport name Port Elizabeth International Airport (PLZ); also accessible via Gqeberha.
stay.airportDirections: From PLZ, head 80 km (about 1 hr 10 min) via N2 toward Grahamstown, then turn off at Bushman’s River and follow signs to Lalibela. Port Elizabeth is the preferred gateway.

why.title: Rooted in Wild, Evolved by Heart
why.body: Lalibela invites you into a living conservation story. From rewilding former farms to nurturing wildlife corridors and human resilience. Ideal for families seeking discovery, couples craving romance in the bush, wellness-focused guests drawn to peaceful spas and starry skies, conservation-minded travelers, and solo explorers hungry for soul‑stirring immersion.

items: Open-vehicle Big‑Five safaris at dawn and dusk
Starlit boma dinners beside crackling fires
Wellness moments at spa & rim-flow pools
All tourism profits reinvested in conservation & communities
Exclusive wildlife encounters, no public roads inside
Personalized service from expert community guides

onlyHere: Whether you’re a honeymoon couple gazing from your plunge pool, a family tracing wildlife tracks, an adventurous solo traveler pursuing lions at first light, or a multigenerational group celebrating together. Lalibela blends wild heart with deep soul. You’ll carry the feeling of this place long after your journey ends.

stay.tagline: Luxury and regeneration in Africa’s wild heart.
stay.quote: Come to Tswalu for a journey that leaves footprints and inspires renewal, both in your heart and across the horizon.
stay.bestMonthsNote: During the dry season, wildlife gathers at waterholes, skies are perfect for stargazing, and daytime game drives are ideal in the crisp weather.
stay.airport:
Tswalu Private Airstrip (flight charter)
Upington International Airport (UTN)
Kimberley Airport (KIM)
stay.airportDirections: The closest option is Tswalu’s own airstrip, with daily charter flights from Cape Town and Johannesburg. Alternatively, fly into Upington (350 km) or Kimberley (370 km) and enjoy a scenic private transfer through the Kalahari.

why.title: A Regenerative Safari Beyond Compare
why.body: Come to Tswalu to experience true wilderness regeneration, a place where luxury meets conservation and every stay gives back to the land.

items: Private game drives with a dedicated ranger and tracker
Guided bush walks and horseback safaris
Stargazing and Malori sleep-outs under pristine skies
San rock art walks and dune-top dining

paras: South Africa’s largest private reserve at 1,200 km² with minimal guest impact.
One of the few places to see desert black rhino, black-maned lion, and pangolin.
Malaria-free and family-friendly, with a Junior Ranger program for children.

onlyHere: Step into the red sands of renewal, where every journey restores both soul and savannah. Tswalu offers a rare blend of luxury in remote wilderness, unmatched exclusivity, and meaningful conservation impact. It is perfect for families, couples, solo explorers, and eco-minded travelers.

camps.name: The Motse
camps.intro: The first time I stayed at The Motse, I felt like the land exhaled, and I exhaled with it. It’s luxury, yes, but stripped back to what really matters: silence, space, and soul. Whether you’re a solo traveler, a couple, or a family, The Motse feels like home in the most its own way.
camps.description: The Motse is where it all began for me at Tswalu and it is the kind of place that gently reorders your sense of time. It is not flashy or overdone. It is warm, grounded, and quietly luxurious, inviting you to breathe deeper, slow down, and simply be.

camps.name: Loapi Tented Suites
camps.intro: Loapi is unlike anywhere else I’ve stayed in Africa. It’s wild, raw, and quietly luxurious in a way that makes you feel like the only person on earth.
camps.description:
Loapi is wild in the truest sense of the word, not because it is rugged or remote, though it is, but because it strips away all the noise. There are no walls between you and the land, just canvas, sky, and silence. You hear the wind move through the grass, the low call of a lion at night, and sometimes nothing at all.
Each tented home stands alone on the landscape. You will not see another soul unless you choose to. It is just you and this vast, powerful wilderness. And yet the experience is anything but basic. Everything is designed with care, from your own chef and butler to spaces that honor both solitude and soul.
units: 6 tented suites, each a private home with its own chef and butler

camps.name: Tarkuni Homestead
camps.intro: With five suites, your own chef, guide, and full team, it’s all yours. No shared spaces, no schedules, just freedom. Tarkuni isn't just a stay, it’s a gathering of souls in the wild. And that’s what makes it its own.
camps.description: Tarkuni feels like a love letter to togetherness. It is the kind of place you go not just to escape, but to reconnect with family, old friends, or even with yourself. The moment I walked through the doors of Tarkuni, I felt a quiet calm. It is completely private, beautifully designed, and grounded in the spirit of the land.
